title: Wendell and the Thorn
author: Rafael Blackwood
blurb: Ansel Winterbourne, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
